messages.subject: oSCR v. 0.02 released
messages.body_plain:
oSCR experimental version 0.02 has been released.

https://sites.google.com/site/spatialcapturerecapture/oscr-package

Major enhancements:
   1.  We changed the parameterization of "sigma" from the log( coefficient )  (a1) to log(sigma).
   2.  We added some basic prediction capacity (see ?predict.oSCR for some terse information abut this).   Does not yet work for models with "sex" as a covariate.
   3.  We added "beardata" (see ?beardata) with an example -- this also has comparisons with 'secr'.
   4.  We did some likelihood improvements that reduce run-time by about 20%.  (big improvements are forthcoming).
   5.  We added full interaction models:  sex*behave*session.

Documentation continues to be sparsely developed but we will work on that.
